findings.note: NBA.com has Thompson averaging 9.7 PPG in about 26 minutes. In his last five games he scored 14, 11, 7, 11 and 4, and the 4 came in a game he left hurt. He has cleared 9.5 in four of his six games this season, with a season-high 14 on 5-of-7 shooting on Nov 2.

RotoWire notes on CBS call Thompson mainly a defensive player who 'isn't a threat offensively on a night-to-night basis', and say his minutes and offensive role are worth watching. They also cover his recent right ankle sprain, which kept him out of the Oct 25 game against Philadelphia.

The Pistons page lists the game as 7-1 Philadelphia at 6-1 Detroit on Nov 4 at 7:00 pm ET. The same page has a note that a Pistons player named Jones missed his fourth straight game, with Wednesday against the 76ers as his next chance to play. Today's injury report for this game wasn't found.
